edge.scope: Unmodified TG daemon /proc RSS/PSS, excluding iperf, monitor and kernel WireGuard memory; no leak-free guarantee beyond observed duration

exit.scope: Unmodified TG daemon /proc RSS/PSS, excluding iperf, monitor and kernel WireGuard memory; no leak-free guarantee beyond observed duration

soak.per_cut_timing_scope: Host-timed path restoration mapped to receiver intervals using pre-launch time; one-second conservative exclusion, not cycle-exact outage latency.

edge.scope: Container charged memory including monitored processes and charged kernel/socket memory; not physical host memory or a leak-free proof.

exit.scope: Container charged memory including monitored processes and charged kernel/socket memory; not physical host memory or a leak-free proof.

loaded_latency.scope: 1500 ICMP probes at 1Hz through the actual kernel WireGuard/TG path during bulk TCP; secondary latency observation, not WAN/DPI evidence
loaded_latency.percentile_method: nearest rank of 1500 rounded reply RTT samples
loaded_latency.variation_scope: Population RTT standard deviation and absolute adjacent 1Hz ICMP RTT differences; a round-trip variation proxy, not one-way IP delay variation or RTP/UDP stream jitter.

faults.scope: Prospective auxiliary diagnostic; primary soak gate unchanged. Intentional all-path blocks may fail the normal zero-loss latency target.
faults.percentile_method: nearest rank of 170 rounded reply RTT samples
faults.variation_scope: Population RTT standard deviation and absolute adjacent 1Hz ICMP RTT differences; a round-trip variation proxy, not one-way IP delay variation or RTP/UDP stream jitter.

all-path-faults.scope: Prospective auxiliary diagnostic; primary soak gate unchanged. Intentional all-path blocks may fail the normal zero-loss latency target.
all-path-faults.percentile_method: nearest rank of 170 rounded reply RTT samples
all-path-faults.variation_scope: Population RTT standard deviation and absolute adjacent 1Hz ICMP RTT differences; a round-trip variation proxy, not one-way IP delay variation or RTP/UDP stream jitter.

soak_cpu.scope: TG /proc PID CPU ticks after first five minutes; receiver bytes are mapped to monitor wall-clock times using pre-launch time. Launch/end overhead and guest/host clock divergence are not corrected; inspect the recorded whole-phase timing difference. This is an approximate diagnostic, not exact cycle attribution. Global Linux CPU counted once includes kernel/iperf/foreign work; not physical Windows-host CPU. No CPU comparison is inferred against a different packet/profile experiment.

historical_scope: Earlier accepted300Mbps milestones and b772 failed latency-coverage/later speed control remain in their existing reports; they do not certify this revision.
remaining: Stable8Gbps/10Gbps for ordinary IP and proxy traffic is unachieved. Current local results do not establish a physical-server ceiling or filtering resilience. Long test offers1Gbps and gates800Mbps plus the separately predeclared original 300 Mbps milestone.
